app.name: Injaz
app.tagline: Plan it. Move it. Get it done.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue to Injaz.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Organize your team's work in minutes.

auth.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

empty.title: Create your first workspace
empty.body: A workspace holds your team's boards. Invite people and give each one a role.

boards.title: Board title

empty.title: No boards yet
empty.body: Boards hold your lists and cards. Create one to get started.
empty.viewer: Nobody has created a board in this workspace yet.

boards.placeholder: The board view arrives in the next update.

leave.title: Leave workspace
leave.body: You'll lose access to its boards. An admin can invite you back.
leave.owner: You're the owner. Transfer ownership before leaving.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.body: The new owner gets full control, including deleting the workspace. You'll become an admin.
transfer.noCandidates: Invite someone first. Only existing members can become the owner.

delete.title: Delete workspace
delete.body: Permanently deletes the workspace with all its boards, lists and cards. This can't be undone.
delete.typeName: Type the workspace name to confirm

members.removeBody: They'll lose access to every board in this workspace and be unassigned from its cards.

invitations.readyBody: Send this link to {email}. It works once, only for that email address, and expires {date}.
invitations.readyWarning: For security, the link is shown only now. You can always create a new one.
invitations.replaceHint: Inviting the same email again replaces its old link.
invitations.manageOnly: Only admins and the owner can see and send invitations.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.wrongAccount: You're signed in as {current}, but this invitation is for {email}.
invite.accepted: This invitation has already been used.
invite.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new link.

profile.title: Profile
profile.avatarHint: A link to an image (https://…). Leave empty to use your initials.

password.title: Change password
password.changed: Password updated. Your other devices were signed out.

myTasks.title: My tasks
myTasks.placeholder: Cards assigned to you across all your workspaces will show up here.

validation.url: Enter a valid link starting with http:// or https://.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

network.error: Can't reach Injaz. Check your connection and try again.

workspace.cannotChangeOwnerRole: The owner's role can't be changed. Transfer ownership instead.
workspace.cannotRemoveOwner: The owner can't be removed. Transfer ownership first.
workspace.memberNotFound: That person is no longer a member.
workspace.ownerRoleNotAssignable: Use “Transfer ownership” to make someone the owner.
